verdicts.originalText: While in Nightsoul's Blessing, Iansan's Charged Attack becomes Swift Stormflight: a single Electro stomp at swiftHitmark=14f (166.4% ATK Electro at lvl=10) instead of the base lunge CA. Normals themselves stay Physical. There is also a 5s post-skill window (gcsim 'fastSkill' status) during which N input auto-converts to a Swift Stormflight CA — the planner only matches NS state, so the post-skill 5s 'free CA' window is not separately gated.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: for 5s after the skill, a Normal Attack auto-triggers a free empowered stomp. The timeline only swaps the Charged Attack while in the Nightsoul state, so a Normal there is shown as an ordinary hit.
verdicts.rationale: The caveat mixes kit explanation and internals with one genuine divergence. The CA-becomes-Swift-Stormflight swap is working behavior (a state-gated dual variant already switches the Charged Attack form on NS), and 'Normals stay Physical' is also working behavior (no infusion authored, so normals correctly render Physical). The hitmark/damage figures are curator internals with banned tokens (14f frame count, swiftHitmark camelCase, gcsim). The only user-facing gap is the trailing one: the 5s post-skill fastSkill window where a Normal press auto-converts to a free stomp is not separately gated (curator notes confirm an apexDrive-equivalent transient-state gap). Compressed to that gap; deleting would cost a true warning, so rewrite. Not implementDelete because the N-to-CA post-action conversion is not wired.

claimsLost.claim: In Nightsoul's Blessing the Charged Attack becomes the Swift Stormflight stomp instead of the base lunge CA
The empowered stomp is a single Electro hit, 166.4% ATK at level 10, at a ~14-frame hitmark
Normals themselves stay Physical during Nightsoul's Blessing

demotedNotes: The Nightsoul Charged Attack (Swift Stormflight) is a single Electro stomp, 166.4% ATK at level 10, hitmark ~14 frames. Only the charge timing is authored on the in-Nightsoul variant (swiftFrames); no infusion field, so the empowered CA's Electro element is not carried and the base normals correctly stay Physical. Genuine gap retained in the rewrite: the 5s post-skill fastSkill window (Normal auto-converts to a free stomp) is not separately gated — apexDrive-equivalent per-cast transient-state gap; the state:nightsoulBlessing match covers the dominant case since NS is active during that window.
